answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and only 14 days to expiry, preserving the incumbent’s proven delivery integration is the lower-risk path. First verify the incumbent stability and prior renewal-benchmarking records, then pursue an accelerated cost and payment-term negotiation. The low-cost vendor meets the spend target, but inherited evidence does not establish delivery reliability under current no-buffer conditions; switching now could create downstream disruption risk. It remains uncertain whether negotiation can fully achieve the mandated 18% reduction.
